servicesIntro: Listed in the order [city] callers need them most. Washers and refrigerators make up about half of all calls.
service_washer-repair: "It fills and drains but won't wash the clothes." "It stopped with water still in it." Washers that won't drain, spin or agitate are our most common call in [city]. The usual causes are a clogged drain pump, a failed lid lock or a worn coupler, and moldy front-load door boots are replaced too.
service_refrigerator-repair: A fridge that runs but stays warm is the most urgent call we get from [city]. The technician checks the evaporator and condenser fans, the defrost system and the start relay before anything expensive. Leaks under the crisper drawers usually trace back to a frozen defrost drain.
service_dryer-repair: Dryers that tumble but won't heat, take two cycles, or stop turning because the drum came off its track. Heating elements, thermal fuses, belts and rollers are replaced in your laundry room, and the vent is checked so the problem doesn't come back.
service_oven-range-repair: Bake or broil elements that quit, gas burners that click but won't light, touch pads that stop responding and cracked glass cooktops. Gas and electric ranges are both repaired at home in [city].
service_dishwasher-repair: Standing water in the tub, a beeping panel that won't start, error codes, and leaks at the sink connection. Drain and spray pumps, inlet valves and door seals are tested and replaced as needed.
service_freezer-ice-maker-repair: Freezers that won't hold zero, ice building up on the back wall, and ice makers that click but don't fill. Water inlet valves and frozen fill tubes are the usual fix.
service_microwave-repair: "It runs, it just doesn't heat anything." That usually means a magnetron, diode or door switch, all high-voltage parts a technician should handle. Broken doors and dead keypads are fixed too.
service_garbage-disposal-repair: Disposals that hum, go dead, trip the reset button or the circuit, or leak under the sink are freed, resealed or replaced.
